authority: User Commerce freeze brief and explicit follow-up decisions; external review is not authority. Freeze covers confirmed core contracts, not unresolved mapping/balance/legacy or technical feasibility.
philosophy: 交换 → 价值发现 → 资本形成 → 时间与风险 → 发展投资 → 资产重组 → 商业信誉。Gold是重要媒介，不是设计终点。

ability_structure.shared_boundary: Design target, not mandatory schema for every future specialization.

description.zh_CN: 零散商人与经营活动在此稳定聚集，形成自发的商业共同体。
同业制度形成稳定职业共同体与商业人才体系。
商业组织发现不同领域的价值，并经营资本的时间与风险。
成熟商业组织配置发展资本、重组既有资产，以长期稳定经营积累信誉。

base_effects.mechanical_contract: Each working Commercial Hub specialist receives additional3Food+3Production at all ACTIVE levels1–4; no old Lv3 upgrade. Native yields remain separate.
base_effects.authority: Legacy COM-001 retained; user explicitly cancelled COM-003 support upgrade in freeze review.

abilities.mechanical_contract: Retain Commerce branch SHARED-001/002; district and each building tier +1Housing; each working Commerce specialist +2 base Merchant GPP with normal percent modifiers. Shared current building/pillage qualification applies.
contracts.capital_investment; stable/venture are two modes of ONE named ability.

output_effects: eligible ordinary building construction Production bonus

input_facts: time as mature Commerce IV system
output_effects: restrained improvements to designated Commerce activities, exact effects unresolved

presentation_contract.existence: Current Identity + permanent Potential defines cumulative current institutions; ACTIVE only controls abilities. Historical State holds former institutions separately; no old ability revival.
presentation_contract.representation: Presentation-only entries in Commercial Hub UI, not engine Buildings; excluded ordinary building counts, HD tiers, Standardization, District Development and default infrastructure value.
presentation_contract.tooltips: RP introduction, own-stage named abilities, necessary current status; technical bits/carriers hidden.
presentation_contract.performance: Event-driven cached state and on-demand rendering. Preserve av2-runtime-b076.103; no periodic scans, per-frame audits or hover requests.

commercialization.capacity: One working Commerce specialist permits one distinct simultaneously commercialized domain; a domain cannot be duplicated by more specialists. No experience/working-duration/continuous-work mechanic.
commercialization.activation: Per-domain toggle; repeat changes allowed in same turn. On capacity reduction, Gameplay cancels most recently enabled domains first (LIFO) until legal. Persist activation order independently of UI sort.
commercialization.local: Commerce city must have corresponding domain district. District Development uses Shared_D0028: maximum single district D=min(10,sum ordinary eligible tiers), completed/nonpillaged buildings, unique replacement normalization; no institution/carrier contribution.
commercialization.source_pool: Self plus other own cities with at least one valid direct domestic Trade Route in EITHER direction between city and Commerce source. Distribution reachability alone does not create this direct-route qualification.
commercialization.selection: For each enabled domain select current strongest legal candidate domain value source. Do not debit source yields; realize additional commercial value as Gold, not copy S/P/C to recipient.
commercialization.deleted: No50/100 directional premium, two-way requirement, deep cooperation or historical partnership.

mapping.notes: Legacy20% S/C/P actual-city copy is not authority for new mapping. Shared domain vocabulary may be reused, but its yield/share/GPP mapping does not define Commerce source values. Government/Diplomatic and future domains remain open; no HD mapping import.

commercialization.formula: Local development participates; exact combination, coefficients, use of shares, cap/floor not fixed. No default rounding.

capital_investment.domain: Player chooses one domain; limited meaningful fundamentals influence quote. Local development, active commercialization and Network/value-source state are candidates, not all mandatory inputs or a frozen formula.

stable.name: 稳健投资
stable.rule: Gold now locked until maturity, certain Gold return later; sacrifice liquidity for time value.

venture.name: 风险投资
venture.failure: 0 < returned Gold < principal, never total principal loss.
venture.risk: Genuine failure chance even with best fundamentals; hard success-probability cap; not strict superior replacement of stable mode.

confirmation_order: Compute effective probability within success hard cap
Update hidden protection according to locked outcome immediately
Persist unique contract, locked outcome, maturity, quote/state version and protection state
capital_investment.protection: Failures improve future actual probability; success reduces or resets protection. Good luck never creates negative punishment. Same-turn later contracts read already updated state; never wait for maturity to update pity.
capital_investment.protection_scope: Per Commerce source city. All venture investment domains of the same source share one hidden protection state; different source cities are independent. Not player-wide and not source-city x domain.
capital_investment.save_load: During investment UI hides outcome; maturity only reveals and settles locked outcome. Ordinary reload before maturity cannot reroll. No claim to prevent reloading before original confirmation.
capital_investment.quote: Gameplay computes principal/term/returns/probability and breakdown; UI displays confirmed snapshot, not player arithmetic or independent formula.

development_investment.qualification: At contract establishment, Commerce source pays Gold and chooses a currently valid OUTGOING domestic Trade Route target city, then an existing eligible domain district in that city. Reverse-only route does not qualify. Post-confirmation route continuity is governed by route_interruption.
development_investment.identity: Target domain need not match target current Specialization Identity.
development_investment.effect: During investment, eligible ordinary buildings in target domain district receive Production construction bonus. Strict ordinary/unique taxonomy and native modifier stacking require prototype.
development_investment.route_interruption: Outgoing Commerce Source -> Target domestic route is qualification ONLY at contract establishment. After confirmation, route interruption, expiry or removal does not pause, terminate, extend or change the existing contract: original duration and effects continue. Without a currently qualified outgoing route, no new contract may be established. City ownership/conquest/source Identity loss remain separate deferred Legacy/Ownership decisions; no inference from route-only continuity.
development_investment.relationship: Independent of Industry Standardization: proactive Gold/route capital allocation versus learned repeatable construction knowledge. May coexist; exact stacking reserved.
development_investment.economics: Reasonable sustained use should produce clearly more long-term construction value than immediate consumption/purchase, compensating liquidity, time, route/domain/capacity commitments. Underuse/strategy change may waste opportunity; no extra reward invented.

restructuring.unit: Commerce ACTIVE4 unlocks special Team, Production only. No Gold/Faith purchase, Great Merchant exchange/sacrifice/recruitment gift or other instant acquisition. Production cost pending.
restructuring.eligibility: Target city must have Current Identity and Potential>=2. Team binds one target city; no intercity capital transfer.
restructuring.liquidation: At target current specialty district execute 资产清算; snapshot P and permanently lose1Potential, reallocatable capital=P-1. Enter REALLOCATING, close old abilities and current source qualification; preserve history.
restructuring.configuration: Move same Team to a new legal specialty district of same target city, execute 资产配置 only after minimum full disruption turns and all valid conditions. New Identity established, Potential=P-1, ACTIVE recomputed under own normal rules; consume Team on successful configuration.

disruption.food_total: Do not reduce total Food directly or change consumption, add starvation damage or remove population. Affect net surplus/growth, not total Food before maintenance.
disruption.end: Timer alone never restores city. Remain REALLOCATING and disrupted until successful configuration; team can move into position earlier.

restructuring.state: REALLOCATING is legal distinct transaction state, never NONE/virgin city/first-completion/Legacy Claim. Historical identity does not supply current ACTIVE or source qualification.
restructuring.limits: No nationwide/per-era/per-city hard usage cap. Cost=source production opportunity+permanent targetPotential loss+target disruption. No additional dynamic population/building/yield Gold fee.
restructuring.history: Former institutions remain independent presentation-only history; no old abilities revived. Per-profession Legacy decides permanent achievements. Research tradition pauses outside Research Identity, retained age resumes on return without catch-up; no inference for other professions.
restructuring.lost_team: DESIGN_DECISION_REQUIRED_DEFERRED_BY_USER: Team killed/deleted after liquidation; replacement/recovery not decided. Persistent transaction must retain assets/evidence independently of unit; no auto recovery/rollback/consumption rule invented.

reputation.accumulation: Longstanding Commerce IV automatically, slowly and discretely accumulates commercial reputation; no points resource, active project or Gold purchase.
reputation.effects: Restrained improvements to existing activities; commercialization and capital investment are candidates. Exact targets among stable/venture efficiency, probability, success/failure return, development remain unresolved; not blanket All Commerce +X%.
reputation.restructuring: Do not infer reputation removes Potential-1 or disruption; no such reward authorized.
reputation.balance: Independent thresholds/speed/effects/cap; do not copy Research tradition numbers or formula.
reputation.legacy: LEGACY_REVIEW_REQUIRED: age retained/paused/resumed/reset on leaving Commerce not decided.

contracts.network: Network outside named ability count. Retain common Trade Center infrastructure; commercialization direct domestic qualification undirected, development direct outgoing directed. No old20% convergence or connected-kind support payload added.

ui.entry: Project list action entries are not ordinary Production Projects. Intercept before native production request to toggle/open panel; never enqueue→FinishProgress→restore queue.
ui.commercialization: One relevant/legal domain toggle, Dashboard fields ON/OFF, working specialists, capacity, localD, highest source, current value, breakdown, unavailable reason; no two-way potential best field.
ui.capital: One 资本投资 entry, one-layer panel: domain, mode, principal, term, stable return, venture probability/success/failure return, fundamentals, breakdown, confirm/cancel together. No wizard.
ui.development: One 发展投资 entry, one-layer target/domain/contract panel: targets, outgoing qualification, district state/D, cost/duration/bonus, contracts/capacity, confirm/cancel.
ui.restructuring: Unit + map/district action; no Commerce project action-entry budget.
ui.data: On panel open acquire one combined quote/qualification snapshot; local selection uses cache, hover zero requests. Confirm one Action request with Gameplay revalidation. No periodic polling.

review_markers.topic: Hidden protection per source city, shared across its venture domains; independent across cities.
Outgoing route checked only at contract establishment; later route loss leaves existing term/effects unchanged; no new contract without qualifying route.
Team deletion/death after liquidation: recovery/replacement not decided.
